'''Echo Amoxliatl''' is a more challenging variant of [[Amoxliatl]] that is accessible during the [[Demonic Pacts League]]. To fight her the player must carry a [[Varlamore echo orb]], which is dropped by the regular Amoxliatl boss.

The unique drop of the echo version is the [[Infernal tecpatl]].

==Mechanics==
Unlike normal Amoxliatl, who follows the player up to a minimum of two tiles from her, Echo Amoxliatl will close the distance. She will use rapid magic-based auto-attacks, indicated with a dark-red icicle unlike her base variant. These can be completely negated by [[Protect from Magic]] and will proc the Thorns pact.

Additionally, Amoxliatl will launch a black icicle at the player's location. Upon hitting the ground, it will erupt, launching blood-red spikes on the target tile and the surrounding area. Any adjacent tile is safe, including diagonally across. The icicle will also leave behind an [[Icy pool (Echo)|icy pool]] on the fired tile that will rapidly deal damage if stood on and will be removed after ~40 or so seconds. The icicle will target as soon as it appears, rather than on attack, so it is important to move once the icicle appears rather than pre-emptively trying to dodge it.

These black icicles will reset the player's attack cycle when dodged at the last possible tick. This can be visually identified by the black icicle being in the air rather than being cast.

At 500 and 250 hitpoints, Echo Amoxliatl will raise her left arm, disable the player's prayers and target a 3x3 circular area on their target tile, leaving behind more icy pools. Failing to dodge these attacks will deal moderately high damage.

At 250 hitpoints, Echo Amoxliatl will enter an enrage phase. She will send out her black icicle attack every two ticks, requiring the player to walk to an adjacent tile '''every other tick'''. Simply turning off run and walking across the arena will not dodge the attack pattern. As above, correctly dodging black icicles will reset the player's attack delay regardless of weapon speed, meaning slow heavy weapons can end the encounter quickly. Despite Echo Amoxliatl no longer using standard attacks during enrage phase, Protect from Magic should be turned back on, or the attack delay reset may not trigger.
